add-subtract-100-skill-01.target: I can find 10 more or 10 less than a two-digit number without counting by ones.
add-subtract-100-skill-01.ifCorrect: You can do this: can find 10 more or 10 less than a two-digit number without counting by ones.
add-subtract-100-skill-01.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Changing the ones digit instead of the tens digit (34 + 10 → 35). Try this: Add or take away one ten rod: only the tens digit changes.

add-subtract-100-skill-02.target: I can add tens to a two-digit number and subtract tens from tens.
add-subtract-100-skill-02.ifCorrect: You can do this: can add tens to a two-digit number and subtract tens from tens.
add-subtract-100-skill-02.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Adding the tens to the ones (40 + 23 → 27), or writing 50 − 20 = 3. Try this: Think in tens: 5 tens − 2 tens = 3 tens, which is 30.

add-subtract-100-skill-03.skill: Adding a Two-Digit and a One-Digit Number
add-subtract-100-skill-03.target: I can add a one-digit number to a two-digit number when no new ten is made.
add-subtract-100-skill-03.ifCorrect: You can do this: can add a one-digit number to a two-digit number when no new ten is made.
add-subtract-100-skill-03.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Adding the one-digit number to the tens (32 + 5 → 82). Try this: Add ones to ones and keep the tens.

add-subtract-100-skill-04.target: I can add a one-digit number to a two-digit number when the ones make a new ten.
add-subtract-100-skill-04.ifCorrect: You can do this: can add a one-digit number to a two-digit number when the ones make a new ten.
add-subtract-100-skill-04.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Writing the ones sum as a digit (38 + 5 → 313). Try this: Fill the ten first: 38 + 2 = 40, then add the 3 left.

add-subtract-100-skill-05.target: I can add two two-digit numbers within 100 by adding tens and tens and ones and ones.
add-subtract-100-skill-05.ifCorrect: You can do this: can add two two-digit numbers within 100 by adding tens and tens and ones and ones.
add-subtract-100-skill-05.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Adding a tens digit to a ones digit. Try this: Draw tens as lines and ones as dots; add each kind separately.
